supersedes: w03.json where conflicting; unchanged schema/API/bridge rules retained

queue.order: FIFO for acknowledged or definitively rejected operations only
queue.outcomeUnknown: abort/network/invalid response after write dispatch sets uncertain true, dirty true, retains last good snapshot, cancels queued writes/save/reload with false outcome; GET view refresh allowed but does not clear uncertainty
queue.recovery: No automatic in-session write recovery. Operator must independently establish backend quiescence/restart before explicitly opening a new browser session; GET does not prove completion. UI exposes uncertainty and keeps writes disabled. No M2 cancellation/idempotency claim.
queue.definitiveRejection: known structured 4xx error; storage_error500 on save/reload only; otherwise dispatched-write failure is uncertain
queue.dispose: client-only: abort active, invalidate publication, cancel queued tasks; backend accepted writes may still commit

selectionTransitions.initial: null, previous null, inspector closed; ignore backend snapshot.selection always
selectionTransitions.selectDifferent: validate id exists, previous=current, current=target, inspector open
selectionTransitions.close: inspector false; selection/history retained; focus invoking entity button when present
selectionTransitions.back: current=existing previous or null, previous=null; inspector open only when current nonnull; focus resulting entity button when present
selectionTransitions.snapshot: prune missing current/previous by kind/id. Missing current becomes null and inspector closes. Never resurrect from backend selection. Existing current survives reload.
selectionTransitions.bridge: receives current selection including while inspector closed; Back/pruning updates propagate; no visibility-based deselection

formOutcome: success|rejected|unknown|disposed; form resets/closes only success, unknown retains input but disables resubmission
scope: W03 foundation; no M1 visual/scene waiver, no backend changes, no persistent selection or credentials
